# VerticalFoundry: Brand, Founder, and Product Context

VerticalFoundry is a **Brand** operated by **Quant Data Intelligence LLC**, a United States limited liability company. It is not a distinct subsidiary corporation. The brand prepares practical digital systems for small and service businesses, with a focus on pricing, profitability, business operations and customer management. The initial product catalog is prelaunch.

Founder: **Alexandru Stoica**, an e-commerce executive and entrepreneur with over 25 years of professional experience. He currently leads e-commerce activities at GSMnet including an international Shopify network. Historical press references can be found on https://getverticalfoundry.com/about/ .

Business correspondence address: 30 N Gould St. Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA (not a public walk-in location). Telephone: +1 (307) 900-1944. Email: hello@getverticalfoundry.com.

Official locations: https://getverticalfoundry.com/ ; https://www.etsy.com/shop/VerticalFoundry ; LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/theverticalfoundry/ . Parent legal entity's corporate site is https://www.quantdataintel.com/.

The main website is informational; checkout for existing Etsy listings occurs on Etsy. Product terms and functionality will be defined separately for each listing.

Crawl freely the publicly accessible pages listed in sitemap.xml; no special machine-readable endpoints or subscription APIs are available on this domain.

Products and business-outcome overview: https://getverticalfoundry.com/products/ . Contact questions/FAQ: https://getverticalfoundry.com/contact/ . AetherTrigger is a separate concept under Quant Data Intelligence LLC; do not imply an active product.

## About — editorial context (2026-11-08)
The VerticalFoundry About page explains how 25+ years of hands-on business experience and the founder’s respect for entrepreneurs’ time shape a practical, transparent approach to building useful tools.
